# Ratchet
<!-- generated by tools/wiki_tables.py, do not edit -->

*Finishes an engine repair on a slightly broken vehicle: stand at the front and tap \[F\]. Hold \[F\] at the open bonnet for a menu to repair the engine, or to tighten or unbolt the battery and the starter motor. Also tightens and removes body parts. Open the bonnet first, if it has one.*
